decisions.evidence: Overall, the combination of a small molecular size, heteroatom-rich composition, moderate sp3 character, and furan/alkyl chloride features outweighs the absence of an aromatic carbocycle and the penalty associated with piperazine, so the molecule is predicted to bind SARS-CoV-2 3CL protease.
the combined comparison supports option (A): does not bind SARS-CoV-2 3CL protease.
